name: soundings
description: Take soundings before you ship. Analyzes GitHub/GitLab compare URLs and produces a clear release verdict - release, manual review, or no-go, computed from the severities of the risks it finds - with an actionable report: categorized concerns, compound-risk detection across repositories, and actionable checks. No external LLM API, no service-account keys - the agent does the analysis, a small Go helper does the fetching.
